Severe (risk $>$ 10 x RAW's risk): declared severe degradation (share of rows); q95: 95 \% quantile of the chosen risk. D18 = deployable features of 1.8.0; D = the deployable features of 1.7.0 (without the 1.8.0 noise-composition features), kept as frozen comparators; +S = with simulator-only features. Model rows are model components (the model's best label-feasible candidate); the full-policy rows call the deployment API itself (guard, out-of-distribution checks, preflight, margin rule, fallback) and are the application's result.
